title: Journey routes
description: Ordered waypoint lists for events that are journeys rather than single places. Language-neutral: waypoint names are read from locations.json, so adding a language needs no change here. An event links to a route by id via its `routeId`.

eventId.description: The event this route belongs to. Must match the event carrying the corresponding routeId.

waypoints.description: Ordered location ids. A waypoint may repeat (a route can pass the same place twice). Waypoints whose registry entry has precision 'unlocated' are listed in the written itinerary but contribute no point to the drawn line.

sourceNote.description: Optional caveat about the itinerary, shown with the route. Use it where the ordering or the positions are uncertain.
